title: 5 Concepts to Know for Coding with AI Agents
description:
Learn more about AI Agents here → https://ibm.biz/~qNwedZihN

AI coding is changing how software gets built. Cedric Clyburn breaks down five essential concepts for working effectively with AI agents, including spec-driven development, context engineering, loop engineering, and AI security. Learn how developers can move from implementation to orchestration as AI becomes part of every software workflow.

00:00 - Will AI Replace Developers? A Real-World Look at the Future
00:53 - The AI Coding Inflection Point: From Autocomplete to Autonomous Features
01:49 - Spec-Driven Development: How AI Agents Build from Requirements
02:28 - Why Developers Are Shifting from Coding to Conducting
03:54 - Context Engineering & Loop Engineering Explained
04:52 - What Every Developer Should Know About How LLMs Work
06:15 - Skills, Automations & Sub-Agents: Building Smarter AI Workflows
07:20 - Prompt Injection Risks and Securing AI Coding Agents
08:25 - Andrew Ng’s “AI Is the New Electricity” Prediction
09:24 - The Future of Software Engineering in an AI-Driven World
